meta.title: Shipping & returns — Saede
meta.description: Where we ship, what it costs, and how returns work.

sections.heading: Getting it to you, without the customs surprise.
sections.lead: Saede exists partly because our founder spent years ordering supplements from another continent. Making this easy in Europe is personal.

sections.note: DRAFT — NOT LEGAL TEXT. Written as a plain-language starting point so the page exists and reads in Saede's voice. It must be reviewed and completed by a qualified lawyer for the EU market before launch. Company registration country is not yet decided (leaning Spain), and several clauses depend on that.
body: Across the European Union. Because the products are made in the EU, there are no customs charges or import duties waiting for you on the doorstep.
PLACEHOLDER — delivery costs and estimated times per country, to be added once the fulfilment partner is confirmed. Delivery cost is always shown at checkout before you pay.
You have 14 days from receiving your order to tell us you are withdrawing from the contract, without giving a reason. Email **hello@saede.eu** and we will tell you what to do next.

**One honest limitation:** for hygiene and safety reasons, sealed food supplements that have been opened cannot be returned for resale. Unopened products in their original packaging can be. This is a standard exception under EU consumer law and we would rather explain it here than have you discover it at the worst moment.
## If something arrives damaged or wrong
Email us with a photograph and we will replace it. We are not going to make you argue for that.
## PLACEHOLDER — to be completed by a lawyer
The formal withdrawal form, return address, who bears return postage, refund timing, and the exact statutory wording for the hygiene exception.
